# Blob

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Blob`](gmeow-Blob.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Blob>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

A content-addressed blob of raw file content — the leaf of a Merkle source tree, independent of filename or path. Aligned to git blob objects and Software Heritage Content by reference. A [`Blob`](gmeow-Blob.md) is the bytes only; the name is carried by the [`TreeEntry`](gmeow-TreeEntry.md) that points to it.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:SourceNode`](gmeow-SourceNode.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Blob`](gmeow-Blob.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:SourceNode`](gmeow-SourceNode.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
